judgeVerdict:
FABLE-JUDGE VERDICT on the KAIF 2.3 → 2.4 update (KAGO, 2026-08-28): VERIFIED WITH CAVEATS.

Claims re-run, not trusted:
1. "Versions stamped" — `node -e` read of `.kaif/kaif.json`: version=2.4, released=2026-08-28,
   history carries both intervals (2.2→2.3, 2.3→2.4 route core-update). CONFIRMED.
2. "Nothing owner-authored lost" — `git status --porcelain` filtered for STATUS.md, GOAL.md,
   MASTER_PLAN.md, plans/, bugs/, ideas/, interviews/, researches/, curves/, runs/: zero modified
   owner files (the only bugs/ change is the NEW ticket 10, an addition). `node tools/prayer.mjs
   --apply` reports all 12 canon copies byte-identical to PHILOSOPHY.md. CONFIRMED.
3. "The merges are real" — AGENT_GUIDE.md now carries exactly one KAIF:CREED pair (lines 7/10) and

   PRINCIPLE / AUTONOMOUS MODE blocks inserted by the mechanical pass were folded out (each block
   counted once by Select-String, 3 patterns → 3 hits); the new WORKING-UNTIL-A-NAMED-TIME rule is
   present once. The kept-for-us module (Russian prayer with the owner's интервью-017 cadence)
   survived verbatim. CONFIRMED.
4. "The project still works" — `npm run check`: 57 .mjs parse, 436 text files encoding-clean.
   `npm run selftest:all`: 29 sets, 0 red, 1421 green blocks, 17.0 s — identical to the numbers
   STATUS.md recorded before the update. `node .kaif/kaif-core.mjs check`: manifest satisfied,
   85 files + 152 agent artifacts. CONFIRMED.
5. "Deprecation done" — old /end-chat removed in all five agent dirs (git rm), pair

  owner has not yet separately ratified them — veto remains one line away.

  unrelated to this update.
- One framework defect found and ticketed, not silently fixed: bugs/KAIF/10 (the placeholders task
